blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala grew up admiring Maria Sharapova’s aggressive, mentally tough approach to tennis. But the Filipino star discovered that the admiration had gone both ways when the five-time Grand Slam champion revealed she had been following her career for several years. The 21-year-old Asian Games bronze medalist received the unexpected acknowledgment during an appearance on Sharapova’s Pretty Tough podcast released on Wednesday. “This is a dream. This is a dream for me,” the rising Filipino star told her childhood idol. Sharapova quickly made it clear that the appreciation was mutual.
